title: Page 341
transc:
No 1.  2PM
Clowry St. Louis  Wash. May 17. 1865
Helen Glory Pope unity I have
decided to sustain your action in
regard tooth Colonization of Missionary Injuns
at Red Wood Zebra Papers indicate
that hostilities are again about breaking
out in Abbot Zodiac If such 
is the case you had better
Wayne that country at once unity
If you have not the whisky
to Dewitt with they Canby furnished
from ladys pontiac Zebra It may
be the injuns require as much
protection saxon whites as the whites
do savory injuns unity my own
Experience has been that but little
trouble would have ever been had
from them but forth Encroachments &
influence of bad whites Walrus Jersey
